The '''variant [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]''' was a starfighter class in use by both the military and the [[Danoor Resistance|resistance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danoor]]. The design of the fighter incorporated a split wing design similar to that of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], large tailfins mounted on the dorsal and ventral engine housings, and two large air intakes on either side of the cockpit. The fighter was armed with two [[Triple blaster/Legends|triple blasters]] and a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launcher.
